text: たいくつ　してた　とこだ

patterns.name: 〜ところだ
patterns.explanation: A past verb plus ところだ means 'was just in the middle of that'. とこ is the casual short form of ところ. たいくつ　してた　とこだ = 'I was just getting bored'.

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ていた after a verb says the action was going on for a while; in casual speech it shortens to てた. たいくつ　してた = 'was being bored'.
